    n = len(customers)

    # -------- helpers --------
    def route_cost(r):

            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]

    def total_cost(routes):

        best_delta = None

            best_delta = matrix[depot][x] + matrix[x][depot]
            return best_pos, best_delta

        # compute delta using edges affected
        for k in range(m + 1):
            if k == 0:
                a = depot
                b = r[0]
            elif k == m:
                a = r[m - 1]
                b = depot
            else:
                a = r[k - 1]
                b = r[k]
            delta = matrix[a][x] + matrix[x][b] - matrix[a][b]
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and x < r[k if k < m else m - 1]):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = k
        return best_pos, best_delta

    # Intra-route deterministic 2-opt (improves while found)
    def two_opt(route):
        m = len(route)
        if m < 4:
            return route
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            # deterministic: first best improvement
            best_i = -1
            best_j = -1
            best_delta = 0
            for i in range(m - 1):

                for j in range(i + 2, m):

                        left_prev = depot
                    else:
                        left_prev = route[i - 1]
                    if j == m - 1:
                        right_next = depot
                    else:
                        right_next = route[j + 1]
                    # current edges: (left_prev, route[i]) and (route[j], right_next)
                    # new edges after reversing [i..j]: (left_prev, route[j]) and (route[i], right_next)
                    delta = (matrix[left_prev][route[j]] + matrix[route[i]][right_next]) - (matrix[left_prev][route[i]] + matrix[route[j]][right_next])

                        best_delta = delta
                        best_i = i
                        best_j = j
